tests.reason: The PostgREST-Aurora proxy's nginx routing has no staging endpoint yet (the prod proxy and its public host come from the dispatch-only workflows of VTID-05023). This builds the real image and proves both audiences against a mock Supabase: internal passthrough of auth/storage/functions/realtime (websocket upgrade, 30 MB upload, 50 MB functions cap), /rest to PostgREST, 501 for unknown paths; on the public host only /rest and /alive, and no request reaches Supabase. It fails on the previous config.

tests.name: GET /auth/config hands the browser the public Supabase URL (R1(b))

tests.reason: R1(b) gateway part: SUPABASE_PUBLIC_URL. With SUPABASE_URL on the internal proxy origin and SUPABASE_PUBLIC_URL on supabase.co, storage public URLs, signed URLs, the video thumbnail URL and GET /auth/config come out on the public origin and never contain the internal host; a guard fails on any new getPublicUrl/createSignedUrl call site not routed through the helper. Staging still runs with SUPABASE_URL on supabase.co, so the HTTP probe above proves today's value is unchanged.
